boundary_conditions: u(0) = (((longitudinal_slip_length - spanwise_slip_penalty_coefficient * transverse_slip_length) * plastron_coverage_fraction) / equivalent_layer_thickness) * du_dy(0)

parameters.name: equivalent_layer_thickness
parameters.justification: Laminar-equivalent wall layer chosen so that b/(delta+b) reproduces the turbulent result DR = 2*b+/U_b+: delta+ = U_b+/2 = 17.5 viscous units = 95 um. y is normalised by this thickness.

parameters.name: edge_velocity
parameters.justification: Velocity at the top of the equivalent layer such that a no-slip wall carries the baseline shear: U_d = tau0*delta/mu = 50*9.5e-5/1.22e-3 = 3.9 m/s, held fixed (same outer flow).

parameters.name: water_dynamic_viscosity
parameters.justification: Seawater at 15 C, converts du/dy into wall shear stress.

parameters.name: spanwise_slip_penalty_coefficient
parameters.justification: Spanwise slip strengthens near-wall streaks and offsets part of the streamwise benefit; Delta U+ ~ b_par+ - c b_perp+ with c ~0.5-0.7 at b+ ~1-2 (Busse & Sandham 2012).

parameters.name: plastron_coverage_fraction
parameters.justification: Share of the hull where the air stays in the grooves; a passive plastron decays within hours to days, so the long-term value is far lower.
